subject: Draft MAP: Performance replay / load test scheduling & capacity ask
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex@acmeai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP: Performance replay / load test scheduling & capacity ask

Alex — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the MAP milestone for performance validation (traffic replay / peak QPS):

1) Goal: Validate peak production behavior for the recommendation endpoint under realistic traffic (95th/99th tails), confirm latency & cost targets, and size dedicated capacity if needed.

2) Proposed MAP milestone — "Load Replay & Peak QPS Validation"
   - Deliverable: Replay run + post-run latency/cost report + regression checks against baseline prompts
   - Target window: candidate windows in the note below (please confirm)
   - Owner (customer): Alex Chen / QA Ops (provide traffic snippet & whitelisted IPs)
   - Owner (Redwood): Karthik Iyer (sales) + Priyom Das (perf eng)
   - Target close date for milestone: 2027-06-12 (aligns with your pilot readiness ask)

3) Dependencies / asks from Acme AI:
   - Production traffic sample or sanitized snippet (we discussed 48k unique sessions; 24-72 hour sample preferred).
   - Typical peak QPS and payload sizes (95th percentile token counts).
   - Any IP ranges / VPN/KV access requirements so we can pre-authorize test clients.

4) Redwood asks / notes:
   - For high-fidelity replay we recommend a dedicated capacity reservation for the test window (we can size after we see the sample). Alternative: burst tests on hosted capacity but risk of noisy neighbors — less predictable latency profile.
   - Priyom will provide a capacity estimate and a 2-option plan (hosted stress vs dedicated pool) once we get the traffic snippet.

Attached: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx (milestones table), prod-traffic-snippet.json (example format), replay-plan-notes.md

Action: Can you confirm the preferred test window (US time) and share the sanitized sample by EOD Wed 5/5? If procurement/PO timing is a constraint, note that in your reply and we’ll propose a fallback run on hosted capacity.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Chen <alex@acmeai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: QA Ops <ops+qa@acmeai.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 12:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Performance replay / load test scheduling & capacity ask

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. Quick answers from our side: we want a high-fidelity replay (same traffic mix) and are leaning toward a dedicated capacity run for the test to avoid interference with our production traffic. A few specifics: 

- Peak observed 95th-percentile QPS: ~1,200 req/s (bursts to 1,600 for up to 30s).
- Typical request payload: median 420 tokens, 95th ~1,100 tokens.
- Session patterns: mix of single-shot inference and short multi-turn (average 1.8 calls/session).
- We can provide a 48-hour sanitized sample (anonymized user IDs) — attaching a short snippet for format reference.
- Preferred test window: weekdays 0200-0500 PT (min traffic in our region) or Saturday 02:00-06:00 PT.
- Procurement: we can expedite a short-term approval but need Redwood's formal capacity estimate and a brief SOW for committed/dedicated pool pricing. Target pilot start: kick-off first week of June, with the MAP milestone closure by 2027-06-12 if feasible.

Attached: prod-traffic-snippet.json (sanitized example)

One more ask: can you confirm whether we need to create test tokens/users or if Redwood can run the replay using our whitelisted simulators?

—Alex
Alex Chen
CTO, Acme AI
alex@acmeai.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@acmeai.com>, QA Ops <ops+qa@acmeai.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP: Performance replay / load test scheduling & capacity ask

Team — forwarding Alex's reply with the traffic snippet. Ask: can we turn around a capacity estimate + two options by EOD tomorrow? The customer prefers a dedicated pool and needs an SOW for procurement. Key inputs below:

- Peak target: 1,200 QPS sustained, bursts to 1,600; payload 95th ~1,100 tokens; mixed single-shot + multi-turn (~1.8 calls/session).
- Preferred windows: weekdays 02:00-05:00 PT or Sat 02:00-06:00 PT.
- Timeline: want to start pilot early June, MAP milestone to close by 2027-06-12.

Please see attached: prod-traffic-snippet.json, MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, replay-plan-notes.md

Requested outputs:
- Priyom: capacity sizing (dedicated pool spec: GPU type, node count, expected throughput and KV memory needs), estimated cost for dedicated reservation and short-term run on hosted, and a recommended test schedule (preferred day & hard windows).
- Marissa / Vivek: please review commercial ask — SOW template + short-term commitment language we can present to procurement.

I'll coordinate back to Alex once we have a draft SOW + sizing.

Thanks —
Karthik

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@acmeai.com>, QA Ops <ops+qa@acmeai.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Performance replay / load test scheduling & capacity ask

Thanks — reviewed the snippet and sketched two viable approaches. Summary below (high level; happy to deep-dive):

Option A — Dedicated short-term reservation (recommended for fidelity):
- Spec: 8 x A100 80GB nodes (NVIDIA A100/80GB), single model shard with distributed KV cache; ~2.5 TB total GPU memory across cluster.
- Expected peak sustained throughput: ~1,300–1,700 req/s depending on batching and prompt mix.
- KV / cache: allocate ~48 GB/node for KV to preserve session performance (tuned during dry run).
- Time required to provision & test: 7 business days from PO + network whitelisting.
- Cost: provide SOW estimate (dedicated reservation + 3-day test window + 2 days staging) — I’ll send numbers in the morning.

Option B — Hosted burst replay (faster to run, lower immediate procurement friction):
- Use multi-tenant hosted capacity with reserved burst pool for test window; expect more variable latency and 10–20% higher tail latency risk during peak bursts.
- Lower cost up-front; no PO required if within hosted quota.
- Can be scheduled within 48–72 hours once we have the snippet and IP allowlist.

Operational asks / prerequisites for either option:
- Whitelist IPs for our test runners (we will provide ranges).
- Test tokens or a short-lived service account from Acme to authenticate replay traffic (preferred).
- Confirmation of compliance needs (no PII in snippet — you indicated sanitized sample, good).

Proposed next steps and responsibilities (MAP milestone update):
- Redwood (Priyom): deliver sizing + SOW draft + calendar windows by 2027-05-05 EOD.
- Acme (Alex / QA Ops): send sanitized 48-hr sample, confirm preferred test window, provide test tokens/whitelist by 2027-05-07.
- Redwood (Karthik/Commercial): draft short SOW and pricing option for procurement review by 2027-05-06.
- Milestone close: 2027-06-12 (validation report & run review).

I can run the staging & dry run on Saturday 05/29 (if provisioned by then) and schedule the full replay for Saturday 06/05 as a candidate. Please confirm whether those Saturdays work for Acme.

Attachments: replay-plan-notes.md (detailed runbook outline)
I'll follow up with the SOW numbers this morning as promised.
—Priyom Das
Perf Eng, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com
